optimizers.name: LiteSpeed Cache
optimizers.notes: LiteSpeed Cache has its own emoji removal under Page Optimization → HTML Settings. The list is short on purpose: it names only settings that exist in the optimizer's own interface, where a site owner can see and change them.

optimizers.name: SiteGround Optimizer
optimizers.notes: SiteGround Optimizer has its own emoji removal under Frontend Optimization. As above, this lists only what the optimizer visibly offers, not everything it might be doing.
